name: Team Umizoomi
description: They're mini, they're mighty and they're built for math! When someone has a problem in Umi City, Milli, Geo, and Bot use their mighty math powers to help save the day!

videos.title: The Kite Festival
videos.overview: Jeannie can't wait to fly her kite at the big Umi City Festival. But, when a gust of wind blows the kite out of her hands and scatters its pieces throughout Umi City, she needs Team Umizoomi's help to find the missing pieces.

videos.title: The Aquarium Fix-It
videos.overview: Michael is at the Umi City Aquarium and there's a big problem! There's a crack in the seahorse tank and the seahorses are in danger! Team Umizoomi rushes over to the aquarium to help save the seahorses.

videos.title: Carnival
videos.overview: Jake calls in from his class trip at the Umi City Carnival. The class is having a great time on all the rides but Jake has a big problem! He's lost his favorite stuffed animal Bunny!

videos.title: Picnic
videos.overview: Team Umizoomi is going to meet Anna for a picnic, when suddenly the Umi Alarm sounds. Anna can't find her thermos or lunchbox! The team must find the missing items and save the picnic!

videos.title: Super Trip to the Supermarket
videos.overview: It's snack time and Samantha's baby brother doesn't have his favorite snack! Team Umizoomi explores the supermarket to tracks down the missing snack foods ingredients.

videos.title: Subway Heroes
videos.overview: Today is Daniel's birthday party, but he's got a big problem! The party is about to start but his Dad is stuck on a broken subway train with the birthday cake! Daniel calls on Team Umizoomi for help, and they jump into action.

videos.title: The Milk Out
videos.overview: UmiCity is out of milk! As it turns out, the farmer is sick in bed and can't get any milk to the kids in the city. Never fear, Team Umizoomi step up and become farmers for the day and make sure milk gets delivered.

videos.title: The Dinosaur Museum Mishap
videos.overview: There's only one thing that scares the dinosaurs at the dinosaur museum-the sound of thunder! So when a big storm frightens them away, it's up to Team Umizoomi find the missing dinosaurs and lead them back home.

videos.title: The Rolling Toy Parade
videos.overview: Today is Umi City Park's Rolling Toy Parade and Nick has been picked to lead the parade! But as he proudly makes his way to the park, his lion toy tumbles down a hill, breaks apart, and its parts are foraged by the park animals!

videos.title: Special Delivery
videos.overview: Olly realizes he forgot to put stamps on a package he sent to his Grandma. Team Umizoomi zooms behind the scenes of the post office, and into the mail system to catch up to the errant package.

videos.title: Ready for Take-Off
videos.overview: The Team is frolicking in the snow on a beautiful winter day when they get a call from Andy at the Umi City Airport. He's on the plane with his family and can't wait to go on his first trip to the beach.

videos.title: Ice Cream Truck
videos.overview: Geo is meeting his friend Dylan so they can go meet the ice cream truck and get some ice cream treats - but when they get to the corner, they find out that the ice cream truck is missing.

videos.title: The Wild West Toy Train Show
videos.overview: Milli, Geo, and Bot can't wait to meet their friend Ethan at "The Wild West Toy Train Show!" But before they hop in the Umi Car for their outing, the Umi Alarm sounds!

videos.title: The Butterfly Dance Show
videos.overview: It's almost time for the "Butterfly Dance Show," but Sophia's butterfly costume isn't finished! Team Umizoomi must complete the costume and get it to Sophia before the curtain goes up!

videos.title: The Elephant Sprinkler
videos.overview: Kayla's fun at the water playground comes to an abrupt end when the elephant water sprinkler stops working! To help Kayla, Team Umizoomi needs to know how water gets to Umi City.

videos.title: Playground Heroes
videos.overview: At the playground, a storm has left the sandbox, swings, slide, and bouncy bridge in disarray! Until everything gets fixed, the park will remain closed! It's a big job, but no job is too big for Team Umizoomi!

videos.title: To the Library
videos.overview: Olivia is sleeping over at her Grandpa's house tonight but she forgot to bring her favorite bedtime story "Goodnight Polka Dot Pirate"! Milli, Geo and Bot are on the case!

videos.title: Favorite Things Show
videos.overview: Milli is visiting her friend Emily's class for Favorite Things Day! That's the day everyone brings in their favorite things to show the whole class.

videos.title: The Big Boat Race
videos.overview: Sonya can't wait to be in the Umi City Toy Boat Race. But just as the race is about to begin, Sonya's boat begins sailing out of control! The mast breaks, the sail is lost, and her lucky gold star charm sinks to the bottom of the pond!

videos.title: Santa's Little Fixers
videos.overview: Santa's Toy-Making Machine is not making any toys! The team must get to Santa's Workshop fast!

videos.title: Race Around Umi City
videos.overview: UmiCar enters a race around the city to try to win the grand prize-a big bunch of balloons-for his friend Sam. But UmiCar will have to out-race Dump Truck, who'll stop at nothing to win!

videos.title: Chicks in the City
videos.overview: Team Umizoomi visits their friend Colin at his school-where six chicks have just hatched! But when the baby chicks mistakenly venture out into the city, it's up to Team Umizoomi to bring them back safely.

videos.title: The Ghost Family Costume Party
videos.overview: It's Halloween and nobody is more excited than the team's newest pal... the hilarious Little Ghost!

videos.title: The Great UmiCar Rescue
videos.overview: When a baby penguin gets his foot stuck in ice, it's UmiCar to the rescue! Equipped with a rope, UmiCar drives to Iceberg Bay and pulls the little penguin to safety.

videos.title: Purple Monkey Mission
videos.overview: There's a new animal coming to the Umi City Zoo-an adorable purple monkey! Purple Monkey's new home has all the things a little monkey needs: tall trees, a tire swing, and monkey bars!

videos.title: Day at the Museum
videos.overview: Milli, Geo and Bot are with their friend Ellen visiting the Children's Museum. Ellen can't wait to try the museum's newest attraction - The Rocket Ship Ride! It costs three star tokens to go on the ride - and Ellen has just the right amount.

videos.title: Super Soap!
videos.overview: Silly Bear has gotten himself into a sticky situation! While working on an arts and crafts project, Silly Bear accidentally squirts glue all over himself. Now everything he touches is sticking to him!

videos.title: Counting Comet
videos.overview: While looking through a telescope, the team discovers a family of comets flying through space! The littlest member of the family is named Counting Comet. He gets his power from counting!

videos.title: Crazy Skates
videos.overview: Bot accidentally puts on a pair of crazy skates and starts rolling out-of-control all across Umi City! Yonk-a-donks! Can Milli and Geo rescue their runaway robot pal?

videos.title: Milli Saves the Day
videos.overview: Milli, Geo and Bot are having a picnic in the woods. But when Geo and Bot accidently disturb the honey bee hive they both get covered in big blobs of sticky honey!

videos.title: Umi Fire Truck
videos.overview: Sound the alarm! There's an emergency in Umi City: a little girl named Abby is up in a tree house and she's too scared to climb down. Milli, Geo, and Bot become firefighters for the day and set off to rescue their friend.

videos.title: Ellee the Elephant
videos.overview: Ellee the Elephant is making her debut at the circus today! But when Ellee gets lost, Team Umizoomi must guide her through the hustle and bustle of Umi City to reach the big top in time.

videos.title: Umi Egg Hunt
videos.overview: The most special egg at the Umi City Egg Hunt has fallen down a rabbit hole! The team chases after it and finds themselves in an underground rabbit city! But they'll have to hurry to nab the lost egg before it gets scrambled!

videos.title: The Legend of the Blue Mermaid
videos.overview: While visiting the beach, Team Umizoomi discovers a statue of The Blue Mermaid. According to the legend, the Blue Mermaid once lived happily in the water by Umi City.

videos.title: Shark Car
videos.overview: The team's friend Jose loses his favorite toy at the beach. It's a shark with wheels... Shark Car! Jose's family is about to leave on a ferryboat, and the only way to return Shark Car in time is for Team Umizoomi to drive it!

videos.title: The King of Numbers (Part 1)
videos.overview: Team Umizoomi visits the King of Numbers in his magical Number Kingdom. But when Zilch, the anti-math wizard, locks the king in his tower, all the numbers start to disappear! Can the team save the king and his kingdom?

videos.title: Umi Toy Store
videos.overview: Team Umizoomi's friend Colin is so excited to buy a new toy! But when Colin's Umicents go missing, the team must go on an educational journey through all the toys and games at the toy store to track them down.

videos.title: Buster the Lost Dog
videos.overview: Milli, Geo and Bot are playing in the park with their friend Anna and her adorable dog Buster. But when a game of fetch goes awry, Buster accidentally jumps into the back of a truck that carries him far, far away... to a construction site!

videos.title: The Incredible Presto
videos.overview: Oh no! The Incredible Presto gets himself trapped in a giant watermelon! It's up to Milli, Geo, and Bot to use Presto's magic wand to save him in time for his magic show!

videos.title: Cuckoo Bears
videos.overview: Team Umizoomi can't wait to see The Cuckoo Bears - a mechanical band of musical bears who live inside the Umi City Cuckoo Clock.

videos.title: Stompasaurus
videos.overview: The Team's friend Wyatt is waiting for the delivery truck to bring his super-cool new toy: Stompasaurus! But when the delivery truck goes down a bumpy road, Stompasaurus' pieces bounce out of the back!

videos.title: Job Well Done!
videos.overview: Milli, Geo and Bot are helping their friend David do chores around the house. As a reward for cleaning his room, David's mom gives him 3 UmiDollars! David is saving his money to buy something really special: a Red Racer Bike.

videos.title: Rainy Day Rescue
videos.overview: When the rainwater washes a nest of baby birds out of their tree, Team Umizoomi must splash their way through streets, parks, and puddles to rescue them!

videos.title: Team Umizoomi vs. The Shape Bandit (Part 1)
videos.overview: There's a Shape Bandit on the loose and he's taking shapes from all over Umi City! But when he takes Geo's Shape Belt, he crosses the line! It's up to Team Umizoomi to get Geo's Shape Belt back and save Umi City!

videos.title: Team Umizoomi vs. the Shape Bandit (Part 2)
Shooting Star!
videos.overview: Shooting Star is the tiniest horse at the ranch. More than anything he wants to be BIG like the other horses. Team Umizoomi takes Shooting Star on a mission to find four magical horseshoes that will make Shooting Star grow.

videos.title: Presto's Magic House
videos.overview: When Presto the Magician accidentally puts his wand in the washing machine, magic bubbles fill the laundry room, and Presto gets trapped inside of one. It's up to the Team to travel through Presto's wacky house and rescue him!

videos.title: DoorMouse In Space
videos.overview: When DoorMouse accidentally gets launched into outer space, it's up to Team Umizoomi to save him. Milli, Geo and Bot must travel past meteors, space aliens and special stars to rescue DoorMouse in time!

videos.title: The Umi Sports Games
videos.overview: Team Umizoomi is playing in the biggest sports event around - the Umi Games! But to win the Umi Games Trophy, Milli, Geo and Bot will have to defeat the Robot Athletes in each event.

videos.title: The Kitty Rescue
videos.overview: The Team's friend Jonathan's kitten is stuck inside a well and she can't get out! Team Umizoomi navigates their way down a river, across a farm and over a mountain to get to Jonathan's house and rescue that kitty.

videos.title: Race to the Top of Shape Mountain
videos.overview: UmiCar and DumpTruck are in a race to the top of Shape Mountain to see who will win the big prize... a magic Dodecahedron! But the Team needs to keep an eye on DumpTruck - he'll stop at nothing to win!

videos.title: Animal School House
videos.overview: Farmer Dan's animals are missing from his farm! Team Umizoomi finds them inside... the Umi City Schoolhouse! The Team goes on an adventure all over the school to search for the mice, chickens, pigs and one stubborn donkey!

videos.title: Doctor Bot
videos.overview: When the Team's friend Mike falls off his scooter and scrapes his knee, it's Dr. Bot to the rescue! The Team sets off to the playground to deliver a bandage to Mike, while they remedy tricky situations along the way!

videos.title: Boardwalk Games
videos.overview: The Team's friend Ryan wants to win a toy helicopter at the Boardwalk Carnival. But it costs 27 tickets! Milli, Geo and Bot play carnival games to earn tickets and help Ryan win the special prize.

videos.title: Lost and Found Toys
videos.overview: The Team discovers a lost and found box with three toys inside. Uh oh! That means there are three kids in Umi City who are missing their toys! The Team sets out to return all the toys to their rightful owners.

videos.title: Let's Play Math Dragons!
videos.overview: The Team plays a video game called Math Dragons. And to win, the Umiz have to journey through three exciting levels and collect all the baby dragon eggs.

videos.title: Haircut Hijinx
videos.overview: The Team's friend Owen is really excited: he's about to get a haircut! But when Owen's money blows away, the Team sets out on a high-stakes adventure to get it back.

videos.title: The Umi City Treasure Hunt
videos.overview: Milli, Geo and Bot are going on a pirate's treasure hunt! The Team takes Umi Pirate Ship and follows the treasure map to fun locations, searching for three special keys to open the great math treasure of Umi City!

videos.title: A Sledding Snow Day
videos.overview: The Team's friend Sanjay is desperate to go sledding, but there's a problem: he doesn't have a sled! Milli, Geo and Bot must embark on a snowy journey through Umi City to bring a super-sled to Sanjay.

videos.title: The Boy With the Dragon Skateboard
videos.overview: Team Umizoomi is visiting the Umi City Skate Park with their friend Logan. Logan has an amazing dragon skateboard and can do all kinds of cool tricks.

videos.title: City of Lost Penguins
videos.overview: Milli, Geo and Bot are at the UmiCity Zoo viewing the newest animal attraction... 50 baby penguins! But when the Troublemakers arrive, they decide to wreak havoc by letting all the penguins loose.

videos.title: UmiCar's Birthday Present
videos.overview: Today is UmiCar's birthday party and everyone's having a fantastic time! But when The Troublemakers crash the party and steal UmiCar's birthday present, the chase is on to get the present back!

videos.title: Robo Tools
videos.overview: The Team's friend Travis and his mom were on their way to his soccer game when their car got a flat tire! It's up to Team Umizoomi to get to Travis and fix his tire in time for his game. And with Bot's Robo-Tools, they can fix anything!

videos.title: The Sunshine Fairy
videos.overview: The Team discovers a secret door to a magical forest. Inside, they meet Sunny the Sunshine Fairy, who has the power of the sun! But when Grog, a jealous gnome, steals her sunshine power, it's up to the Team to help her get it back!

videos.title: Little Panda Joe
videos.overview: A baby panda named Little Joe is lost in Umi City! The Team finds him and sets off on a journey to take him back home to his family at the Panda House, taking good care of him all along the way.

videos.title: Stolen Lunches
videos.overview: The Team is visiting their friend's school when The TroubleMakers steal all the kids' lunches! Milli, Geo and Bot take off in hot pursuit to get the lunches back before The TroubleMakers reach their secret picnic spot!

videos.title: Meatball Madness
videos.overview: When The TroubleMakers take away the stop button from Chef Mario's Meatball Machine, the city fills up with millions of meatballs! It's up to Milli, Geo and Bot to get that stop button back and save Umi City from meatball madness!

videos.title: Umi Grand Prix
videos.overview: UmiCar and Shark Car are revved up for the big race- the Umi Grand Prix! With tough competitors like Shape Bandit, Dump Truck, Squiddy, and The TroubleMakers, winning will be a big challenge. Racers, start your engines!

videos.title: Gloopy Fly Home
videos.overview: Gloopy Fly Home: Team Umizoomi finds a little alien named Gloopy who crash-landed in Umi City. Gloopy wants to go home, but his spaceship is missing the star crystals that make it fly. The Team helps Gloopy find the missing crystals so he can go home.

videos.title: Movie Madness!
videos.overview: It's a night out at the movies for The Team. But The TroubleMakers show up and make off with all the movie snacks!

videos.title: Umi Ninjas
videos.overview: Team Umizoomi wins the coveted Ninja Trophy, but suddenly, Squiddy the Squid swipes the trophy for himself! Milli, Geo and Bot break out their super ninja skills to track down Squiddy and get their trophy back!

videos.title: UmiCops!
videos.overview: The chief of police calls the UmiCops with a big case: to catch the 12 Stinkbugs who are on the loose and causing a stink wherever they go.

videos.title: Umi Knights
videos.overview: Milli, Geo and Bot are brave UmiKnights today! Just then, the Princess calls with a problem. Max the Dragon lost his glasses and is flying around bumping into everything in the kingdom!

videos.title: Lost Fairy Tales in the City
videos.overview: Zeppo the Wizard's magic wand accidentally zaps a book of fairy tales and the characters are flung out of their stories and all throughout Umi City!

videos.title: Sleeping UmiCar
videos.overview: Team Umizoomi is visiting their friend Zeppo the Wizard. When Zeppo's magic sleeping potion makes UmiCar fall fast asleep, it's up to the Team to get the ingredients for the wake up potion!

videos.title: Gizmos Gone Wild!
videos.overview: There's mayhem at the Umi City Mall when a group of little Gizmo robots malfunction and wreak havoc through the shops, food court and department stores. Will Team Umizoomi's mighty math powers be able to wrangle these Gizmos?

videos.title: Umi Space Heroes (Part 1)
videos.overview: When The TroubleMakers break the moon into four pieces, Milli, Geo and Bot blast off in Umi SpaceShip on an intergalactic adventure. Nothing can stop our Umi Space Heroes from saving the moon!

videos.title: Umi Rescue Copter
videos.overview: The Team gets a distress call from way out in the ocean. Their friend Danny the Dolphin hurt his tail and can't swim! UmiCar transforms into Umi Rescue Copter and the Team sets out to save Danny and fix his tail.
